about: From power-on with nothing saved: the menus, Sonic in the character select with Cosmic Angel Zone open, the course select down to Cosmic Angel Zone, its last Down a frame later than the beat of the others so the menu's sound keeps in step, and A on it, and the act's title card, all played in both; then at frame 2542 Sonic is put in the air over the act's special spring with the camera on it, as the start point puts the Dreamport's: he lands on it and rises into special stage 7, left alone to its end and its results, after which Cosmic Angel Zone comes back with its title card and Sonic by the spring, left alone.
